challenge.method: Compare explicitly open and abstract classes, sealed classes, closed declaration kinds and interfaces in the pinned chapter. Cross-check direct, indirect and multiplatform sealed subclasses at https://kotlinlang.org/docs/sealed-classes.html.
challenge.results: A sealed class is implicitly abstract although the explicit sealed and abstract modifiers are exclusive. Direct sealed subclasses require a fully qualified name and the package and module prescribed by the pinned rule. Indirect descendants and expect/actual source sets have distinct treatment. Data, enum and annotation classes remain closed under this pin.

limitations: Pinned Kotlin/Core class declarations. The claim concerns openness by default and the effect of sealed on abstractness.
